title: The Twin Azure Hawk Bo Canon of the Court
summary: The court canon of the Azure Sky bo, pairing a hawk's high guard with a twin stroke for Xiantian students.

title: River Through the Basin: Elite Bo Forms
summary: Elite forms in which the staff runs through an opponent's stance like a river through a basin, guided by qi.

title: Dual-Track Elite Bo of the Paired Courts
summary: Teaches two simultaneous tracks of guard and strike, one in each end's qi field, to advanced Xiantian students.

title: Hawk-Stoop Bo Sovereignty Course
summary: A long course on hawk-stoop descents that turn the staff's fall into command of the ground below it.

title: Azure Twin-Wing Bo Doctrine
summary: A doctrine in which both ends of the staff move as twin wings, one drawing the guard and one striking.

title: The Paired River Bo Elite Rolls
summary: A short set of elite rolls that run two currents of qi down the staff and join them at the strike.

title: Court of Two Reaches: Elite Bo Method
summary: A court method that holds one reach at close quarters and one at distance, the qi field joining both.

title: Wind-Sworn Bo Elite Oath Course
summary: An oath course for the wind-sworn, teaching the staff to follow a sworn bearing through every shift of the wind.

title: Elite Bearings of the Plateau Bo
summary: A set of elite bearings taken on the open plateau and held with the staff against any opponent.

title: Bo Without Walls: The Elite Gale Course
summary: A course that guards by flowing movement and never by a fixed position, for Gale students of Xiantian standing.

title: Windward Oath Treatise for the Bo
summary: A treatise sworn on the windward edge, binding the staff and the student's qi field to one oath.

title: Plateau-Edge Bo of the Wind-Sworn Elite
summary: A large course on the plateau's edge, where the staff both guards the drop and drives the opponent over it.

title: Sworn Gale Bo and the Held Bearing
summary: Teaches the sworn student to keep one bearing under the gale while the field around the staff shifts.

title: The Great-Wind Bo Elite Doctrine
summary: A doctrine of the great wind, in which one stroke draws the wind's weight from the whole plateau behind it.
